title: Role of Melatonin Supplementation in Follicular Fluid of in Vitro Fertilization (IVF) Patients With Polycystic Ovarian Syndrome
brief_summary: To evaluate the effects of melatonin supplementation on the main in vitro fertilization (IVF) outcomes during ovarian stimulation in patients with Polycystic ovarian syndrome (PCOS).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* diagnosis of PCOS
* irregular menstrual cycle (\> than 28-30 days)
* normal uterine cavity
* body mass index of 20 to 26 Kg/m2
* first IVF treatment

Exclusion Criteria:

* presence of tubal, uterine, genetics and male causes of infertility
* diagnosis of cancer
* hormonal treatment in the last six months
